notes.title: Twins & Dreams – A Unique Puzzle Adventure Coming Soon to Steam
notes.notes: [p][b]Twins & Dreams[/b] is a colorful 2D puzzle game set in a dreamlike world. Players control two characters who move in the same direction at the same time, solving grid-based puzzles that challenge both logic and imagination. To escape, you must guide both dreamers to the button simultaneously while avoiding ghostly enemies and using helpers like ghost hunters, portals, and walls.[/p][p]🗓 [b]Demo Release: October 1st[/b][/p][p]🚀 [b]Full Launch: October 23rd[/b][/p][p]Add [i]Twins & Dreams[/i] to your wishlist and be part of our journey toward launch![/p]
